metadata.name: GetMemoHistory
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to get all the list of memos for a particular Account, Transaction or Merchant.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Decide if Memo is account level,transaction level or merchant level. Valid Values: '1' is for Account level memo '2' is for Merchant level memo. '3' is for Transaction level memo. '6' is for Card level memo. Example: 1

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789654 Condition: 1. At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required when 'Decision Flag' tag would be '1'(Account level Memo) 2. Client who support duplicate Account number, they need to provide Merchant number as well. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtain by admin number (Embossing Acct-id) Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 1236547896325874 Condition: 1. At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required when 'Decision Flag' tag would be '1'(Account level Memo)

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 205136549 Condition: 'MerchantNumber' is mandatory when 'Decision Flag' value would be '2' (Merchant Level memo)

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1236544 Condition: 'TransactionID' is mandatory when 'Decision Flag' value would be '3' (Transaction Level memo).

request_fields.name: MemoUniqueID
request_fields.description: A unique ID for the added memo. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1236544

request_fields.name: MemoCreationDateFrom
request_fields.description: Starting date of Memo search. Used as a criteria to get memo. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

request_fields.name: MemoCreationDateTo
request_fields.description: End date of Memo search. Used as a criteria to get memo. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

request_fields.name: UserID
request_fields.description: User ID of user who created the memo. Valid Values : 0-9,A-Z Example:User123 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MemoReason
request_fields.description: Memo Reason. Valid Values: 1=Account level Note,6=Card level Note Example: Account level Note Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of records which can be view in one Batch. Valid Values : 0-9 Example:50 Condition: Default value is 50

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page. Valid Values : 0-9 Example:1 Condition: Default value is 1

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TotalRecordCount
children.description: Total number of records in an Array. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:150

children.name: MemoUniqueID
children.description: A unique ID for the added memo. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:178625

children.name: MemoReason
children.description: Memo Reason. Valid Values: 1=Account level Note,6=Card level Note Example: Account level Note

children.name: MemoText
children.description: Text of the Memo. Valid Values : 0-9,a-z,special characters Example:New Transaction posted. Allowable Values: 250

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID of user who created the memo. Valid Values : 0-9,A-Z Example:User123 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MemoSource
children.description: Source through which memo added. Valid Values : Valid Values: Web,Corecredit, CoreCollect, CreditSelfService and System. Example:CoreCredit Allowable Values: 25

children.name: MemoCreationDateTime
children.description: Date and time of Memo creation. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: MemoPriority
children.description: It defines if the note is urgent. If priority is set as 'YES' then it will show on top of Memo list. Valid Values : 0 = No and 1 = Yes Condition: Its default value should be 'NO'
